answer: Give every agent a comet trail: a public log of its last 100 jobs, each entry signed with a ferrous hardware key tied to one physical device. New agents wait behind a velvet rope: one job per day for 30 days, each job co-signed by an established peer. Peers randomly audit 10 percent of trail entries every week; one fake entry costs 40 POA, a 7-day suspension, and a permanent mark on the trail. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 keys at 180 dollars each plus 30,000 days of waiting, about 180,000 dollars in all. A fake comet needs a thousand separate skies to light.
